definitions.private_bytes: Windows private committed virtual memory; includes nonresident private pages
definitions.working_set_bytes: Resident working set, includes shared pages; process sums can double-count sharing
definitions.cpu_one_core_percent: 100 percent means one fully occupied logical CPU; divide by 32 for whole-machine share
definitions.hard_fault_read_operations_per_sec: System-wide Memory Page Reads/sec disk read operations
definitions.hard_fault_pages_in_per_sec: System-wide Memory Pages Input/sec pages brought in to resolve hard faults
definitions.sampling: Approximately 0.5 seconds plus collection time; brief analysis phases can be missed
